text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article. Its primary focus is modeling pollinator community responses (bees) to hypothetical bioenergy-driven land-use changes, not on predicting or simulating Land Use Land Cover (LULC) change itself. The LULC scenarios (conversion of 600,000 ha) are pre-defined, static inputs used to assess ecological impacts. The paper does not implement a spatial LULC prediction model, generate new LULC projections, or report LULC prediction accuracy metrics. It uses existing land cover data to model pollinator metrics, which is an application of LULC data, not a prediction of LULC.)
